rules: Mixed: reuse one genuine PPCPP initial plan for common initial prefix; each method then executes independently. Events at 20/30/40/50/60% of original-task count: straight expansion, obstacle1, corner expansion, obstacle2, obstacle3. Publish each only at its local checkpoint; same geometry across methods. All methods paused at checkpoint before event selection. Obstacles chosen without solving candidates: never visited by ANY method, on ALL remaining old coverage plans, some pending task after first hit for each, all remaining tasks/base reachable. Prefer newly published area then minimum total distance from current positions, lexical tie-break. Shapes:1cell, horizontal2(vertical2 fallback), L3; singleton fallback only if larger fixed templates have no qualified placement. Stop world if no placement. No outcome-conditioned retries. Obstacles may be ahead not immediately next to every current position.
limitations: Progress-conditioned common-coordinate events, not common wall clock; one seed. No general ranking across differing completed/deferred sets. Time includes only calls actually made, not archived preparation. Synthetic mixed maps, frozen historical algorithms.
